MVBeliefUpdatr Stanfit Classes and Constructors

Source: R/S7-stanfit.R
MVBU_Stanfit.Rd

An S7 base class for Stan fit objects.

Usage

MVBU_Stanfit(
  data = list(),
  staninput = NULL,
  stanvars = NULL,
  backend = "rstan",
  save_pars = NULL,
  stan_args = list(),
  stanfit = NULL,
  transform_information = NULL,
  criteria = list(),
  file = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  cache = list()
)

Arguments

data

A named list containing $original and $transformed data frames. Default: list().

staninput

A Stan input object containing the data handed to rstan (an IdealAdaptorStaninput object). Default: NULL.

stanvars

A stanvars object or NULL. Default: NULL.

backend

The name of the backend used to fit the model (character). Default: "rstan".

save_pars

Optional storage for saved parameter names. Default: NULL.

stan_args

Named list of additional control arguments that were passed to the Stan backend directly. Default: list().

stanfit

An object of class stanfit containing posterior draws. Default: NULL.

transform_information

An object of type MVBU_TransformInformation or NULL. Default: NULL.

criteria

An empty list for adding model fit criteria after estimation of the model. Default: list().

file

Optional name of a file in which the model object was stored in or loaded from. Default: NULL.

version

The versions of MVBeliefUpdatr and rstan with which the model was fitted. Default: NULL.

metadata

List containing auxiliary information including label_information. Default: list().

cache

Internal cache list storing pre-extracted $draws and $summary objects populated by add_posterior_latents. Default: list().

See also

add_posterior_latents, fit_ideal_adaptor, vignette("fitting-and-working-with-stanfit-models")

Examples

# Instantiate an empty Stanfit container object
fit <- MVBU_Stanfit()
is(fit, "MVBU_Stanfit")
#> [1] TRUE

# \donttest{
# Load a pre-compiled example Stanfit object
ex_fit <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit()
#> Warning: The largest R-hat is NA, indicating chains have not mixed.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#r-hat
#> Warning: Bulk Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior means and medians may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#bulk-ess
#> Warning: Tail Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior variances and tail quantiles may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#tail-ess
class(ex_fit)
#> [1] "NIW_IdealAdaptorStanfit" "IdealAdaptorStanfit"    
#> [3] "MVBU_Stanfit"            "MVBU_Object"            
#> [5] "S7_object"              
# }
